1251-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5078-7902-8176.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

141-2511-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2523-2869-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2523-2869-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2523-2869-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-4094-4365-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-4094-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1671-3177-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

3617-5913-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5223-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-1778-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1778-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1308-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3755-4068-7686.notablePrerequisites:
You control four or more Squirrels.
You control at least one Mountain.
3755-4068-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-4068-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6702-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6702-7009-7715.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Kilo, or you have another method to tap Kilo.
6702-7009-7715.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Tap Kilo. It triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2034-3129-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3129-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

997-4871-6705.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1651-3875-4426-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-3875-4426-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-3875-4426-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

413-1669-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
413-1669-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When World Shaper enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat
413-1669-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1479-4677-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

703-2034-4394-4875.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

5617-5686-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
5617-5686-6553.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

116-1719-5329.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

457-1247-5149.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
457-1247-5149.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Pili-Pala, adding {U}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

527-969-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-969-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

1283-2825-3525-4739.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three creatures.
1283-2825-3525-4739.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Battle Hymn without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Battle Hymn, adding at least {3}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures, this combo nets infinite mana.

2782-5003-5231.notablePrerequisites: At least two creatures have died this turn.
2782-5003-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Nevinyrral, adding {R}.
When Nevinyrral dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nevinyrral trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Nevinyrral to the battlefield from your graveyard, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Nevinyrral enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each creature that has died this turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Zombie tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

33-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
33-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Loyal Apprentice triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

198-1409-2905.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with Pestermite.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least one charge counter on it.
198-1409-2905.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Pestermite by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pestermite.
Repeat.

1769-2201-3300-3983.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Meathook Massacre triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

47-2232-3273-5012.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra Nalaar onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Novice Pyromancer to your hand.
+1 Chandra Nalaar targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Novice Pyromancer onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra Nalaar to your hand.
-1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2060-3048-5003.description:
Sacrifice Roalesk to Ashnod's Altar generating two colorless, with Roalesk's death you proliferate twice, putting two more counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Remove those counters for two mana, use the other two mana from Ashnod's to return Roalesk to the battlefield using Nim Deathmantle.
Repeat.
